title: Unit Event — Friendship Rebuilt — Episode4 Think Hard On It

meta.Event Outline: In the wake of iHaz, MORE MORE JUMP! are inundated with work offers. After taking a fresh look at their schedule, Airi and the rest of MMJ consider adopting a work style that makes use of the credit-based course.

rows.Line: The next day - After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know it's earlier than usual, but I wonder if the others are already gathered on the rooftop...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Oh, it's Shiho and Kohane... And Minori, too. Right, they're all in the same class.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Bye bye, Minori!
Let's check out that new cafe sometime soon!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! That includes you, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, relax.
I'm not about to break my promise.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, see you later.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! Bye bye, Shiho, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hehe. They're so close...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Huh? What happened...?
She looks really concerned now...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-Airi...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're heading up to the rooftop for practice, right? Let's go together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
By the way, was something the matter?
You looked lost in thought there.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There's this thing that's been on my mind lately.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Something that's been on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah... Actually, Airi, would you mind if we talked about it for a second?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, go ahead. Lay it on me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks!
So, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Going credit-based...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I mean, it makes sense for Minori to consider making that switch. She's serious about making it big as an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (And there's no question that we'll be able to do more as MORE MORE JUMP! if she makes that switch. But at the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka said that I should give it more careful thought since going credit-based also means switching to a really different lifestyle...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Like not being able to see my friends as much...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I agree with what Haruka told you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, Minori, how do you feel after hearing what she said...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I, um...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I agree with Haruka that the credit-based course has lots of advantages since it gives people like us a chance to work more.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But at the same time, I don't think I've been able to see things from the other perspective she gave...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean, I don't have prior experience working as an idol like the rest of you, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've always had friends and classmates around me, and they'd give me their support whenever I told them that I wanted to become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You want to become an idol...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's amazing...!
Good luck. I'll be rooting for you...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: After we formed MORE MORE JUMP! and started putting on events in real life, including our solo show, I had a little less time to talk to or see my classmates... But...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori, want to have lunch with Shiho and me today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-Sorry! I'm having a meeting with Haruka and the others during lunch today...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, okay. That's too bad...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I'm really sorry...
But thank you for inviting me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You don't need to apologize.
We know it's really important to you, so it's okay if it takes priority.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, she's right.
So, Minori, good luck with your solo show. I'll be rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Kohane... Shiho...
Thank you both so much...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They've been there by my side this entire time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But if I switch to the credit-based course, what Haruka said might actually happen. A gap might start forming between me and my friends...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't think my mind has been able to fully comprehend how painful that might be...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why I need to give this decision more thought.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Minori's been thinking seriously about what she might lose if she were to go through with this...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (And I believe that step is absolutely necessary.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Not only is your lifestyle gonna get turned on its head...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, Airi, did that happen to you...?
Did you and your classmates become more and more distant because you were credit-based...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it happened to me too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see. I had a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I agree with Haruka on this one...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (In simple terms, switching to the credit-based course will allow us to do more as MORE MORE JUMP! But you'll sorely regret it if you leap before you look...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Because...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Minori has Shiho, Kohane and a ton of other close friends.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (If possible, I don't want her to experience what I did back then...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But Minori's been seriously thinking about what she and we can do as MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (This decision is ultimately up to her...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks for talking with me about this, Airi! I'm gonna keep giving it some more thought.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Sure.
Feel free to ask again if you have any questions.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!
